complaints.description: Past Integrity product line had wood rot issues leading to recall/replacement program (pre-Ultimate rebranding)
complaints.source: Consumer complaint history, Marvin replacement program documentation
complaints.note: Historical issue from Integrity line. Marvin addressed with design changes in Ultimate rebrand. YELLOW not RED because it's historical and remediated.

sources.name: GBA contributor
sources.summary: Positive assessment of casement performance, noted installation concerns. Professional endorsement with qualifications.

professional_consensus._note: Single Pool A source with positive sentiment. No Jay Johnson/TheWindowDog evaluation found for Signature Ultimate specifically.

component_quality._note: Extruded aluminum cladding with AAMA 2605 coating, Cardinal glass with stainless steel V-shaped spacer (dual seal), wood interior. Documented premium components.

repairability._note: Established manufacturer with long parts availability history. IGU replacement via glass swap through dealer network.

thermal.note: NFRC certified, Energy Star qualified. Wood frame with aluminum cladding — inherently low frame conductivity. Triple-pane available. No specific DH U-Factor published.

structural.note: AAMA Gold Label certification confirms product passed all performance tests including structural. Strong structural reputation from professional sources.

air_water.note: Manufacturer does not publish air infiltration value for DH configuration. Energy Star / NFRC certified indicates minimum standards met. Scored at certification floor for wood_clad material class. Actual performance may be significantly better.
